title: Fairness for the People, by the People: Minority Collective Action

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Equalized Odds and Statistical Parity violations on the COMPAS, Adult, HSLS, and ACS-Income datasets, where race is the designated sensitive attribute, before and after applying algorithmic collective action (data relabeling).

Evaluating Equalized Odds and Statistical Parity violations on the CivilComments dataset for toxicity detection, specifically comparing comments that include either 'Christian' or 'Muslim' identities as the sensitive attribute.
Evaluating Equalized Odds and Statistical Parity on the Waterbirds dataset, using the image background (land or water) as the sensitive attribute to measure reliance on spurious features.
